";

class SoundEngine {
    constructor() {
        this.ctx = null;
        this.storageKey = 'moonshift.audio.v1';
        this.masterVolume = 1.0;
        this.sfxVolume = 0.75;
        this.musicVolume = 0.42;
        this.voiceVolume = 1.0;
        this.musicMuted = false;
        this.sfxMuted = false;
        this.voiceMuted = false;
        this.muted = false; // master mute
        this.initialized = false;
        this.ambientOscillators = [];
        this.ambientGain = null;
        this.ambientNoise = null;
        this._musicMotion = null;
        this.ambientMood = 'moon';
        this.alarmInterval = null;
        this._voiceDucked = false;
        this._loadSettings();
    }

    _loadSettings() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
            if (!raw) return;
            const s = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (typeof s.musicVolume === 'number') this.musicVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.musicVolume));
            if (typeof s.sfxVolume === 'number') this.sfxVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.sfxVolume));
            if (typeof s.voiceVolume === 'number') this.voiceVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.voiceVolume));
            if (typeof s.musicMuted === 'boolean') this.musicMuted = s.musicMuted;
            if (typeof s.sfxMuted === 'boolean') this.sfxMuted = s.sfxMuted;
            if (typeof s.voiceMuted === 'boolean') this.voiceMuted = s.voiceMuted;
            if (typeof s.muted === 'boolean') this.muted = s.muted;
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    _saveSettings() {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify({
                musicVolume: this.musicVolume,
                sfxVolume: this.sfxVolume,
                voiceVolume: this.voiceVolume,
                musicMuted: this.musicMuted,
                sfxMuted: this.sfxMuted,
                voiceMuted: this.voiceMuted,
                muted: this.muted
            }));
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    getEffectiveMusicVolume() {
        if (this.muted || this.musicMuted) return 0;
        return 0.38 * this.musicVolume * this.masterVolume * (this._voiceDucked ? 0.35 : 1);
    }

    getEffectiveSfxVolume() {
        if (this.muted || this.sfxMuted) return 0;
        return this.sfxVolume * this.masterVolume;
    }

    getEffectiveVoiceVolume() {
        if (this.muted || this.voiceMuted) return 0;
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, this.voiceVolume * this.masterVolume));
    }

    init() {
        if (this.initialized) return;
        try {
            const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            this.ctx = new AudioCtx();
            this.resume();
            this.initialized = true;
            this.startAmbientMusic();
            this.updateAudioButton();
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Web Audio not supported or blocked by autoplay:', e);
        }
    }

    resume() {
        if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
    }

    playTone(freq, type = 'sine', duration = 0.1, gainVal = 0.2, pitchDecay = 0) {
        const eff = this.getEffectiveSfxVolume();
        if (!this.ctx || eff <= 0.001) return;
        this.resume();
        const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
        const filter = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        osc.type = type;
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
        if (pitchDecay !== 0) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, freq + pitchDecay), now + duration);
        filter.type = 'lowpass';
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.max(450, freq * 2.2), now);
        const vol = Math.max(0.0001, gainVal * eff);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, now);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
        osc.connect(filter);
        filter.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        osc.start(now);
        osc.stop(now + duration);
    }

    footstep(surface = 'ceramic') {
        const eff = this.getEffectiveSfxVolume();
        if (!this.ctx || eff <= 0.001) return;
        this.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const bufferSize = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.035;
        const buffer = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, this.ctx.sampleRate);
        const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
        for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.exp(-i / (bufferSize * 0.28));
        const noise = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
        noise.buffer = buffer;
        const filter = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
        filter.type = 'lowpass';
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(surface === 'metal' ? 760 : 480, now);
        const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.055 * eff, now);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.035);
        noise.connect(filter);
        filter.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        noise.start(now);
    }

    uiClick() { this.playTone(620, 'sine', 0.05, 0.10, 120); }
    uiConfirm() {
        this.playTone(523.25, 'triangle', 0.08, 0.14);
        setTimeout(() => this.playTone(659.25, 'triangle', 0.12, 0.14), 70);
    }
    uiError() {
        this.playTone(220, 'sawtooth', 0.14, 0.11, -60);
        setTimeout(() => this.playTone(175, 'sawtooth', 0.16, 0.10, -40), 110);
    }
    taskSuccess() {
        [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5].forEach((f, idx) => {
            setTimeout(() => this.playTone(f, 'triangle', 0.16, 0.13), idx * 80);
        });
    }
    doorOpen() {
        const eff = this.getEffectiveSfxVolume();
        if (!this.ctx || eff <= 0.001) return;
        this.playTone(140, 'sine', 0.22, 0.08 * eff, -40);
    }
    pixChirp(emotion = 'normal') {
        const base = emotion === 'alert' ? 680 : emotion === 'happy' ? 840 : 580;
        this.playTone(base, 'sine', 0.07, 0.09, emotion === 'alert' ? -90 : 120);
        setTimeout(() => this.playTone(base * 1.18, 'sine', 0.07, 0.08, 60), 65);
    }
    startAlarm() {
        this.stopAlarm();
        this.alarmInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (this.getEffectiveSfxVolume() > 0.001) this.playTone(440, 'sine', 0.18, 0.08, -80);
        }, 2600);
    }
    stopAlarm() {
        if (this.alarmInterval) { clearInterval(this.alarmInterval); this.alarmInterval = null; }
    }

    startAmbientMusic() {
        if (!this.ctx) return;
        try {
            this.resume();
            this.stopAmbientMusic();
            const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
            this.ambientGain = this.ctx.createGain();
            this.ambientGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
            this.ambientGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(Math.max(0.0001, this.getEffectiveMusicVolume()), now, 0.45);
            this.ambientGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

            const token = (this._bgmToken = (this._bgmToken || 0) + 1);
            const startBuffer = (buffer) => {
                if (this._bgmToken !== token || !this.ctx || !this.ambientGain) return;
                const src = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
                src.buffer = buffer;
                src.loop = true;
                src.connect(this.ambientGain);
                src.start(0);
                this.ambientOscillators = [{ osc: src, lfo: null }];
            };

            if (this._ambientBuffer) {
                startBuffer(this._ambientBuffer);
            } else {
                const b64 = AMBIENT_BGM_DATA_URI.split(',')[1];
                const bin = atob(b64);
                const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
                for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
                this.ctx.decodeAudioData(bytes.buffer.slice(0)).then((buffer) => {
                    this._ambientBuffer = buffer;
                    startBuffer(buffer);
                }).catch((e) => console.warn('Could not decode ambient BGM:', e));
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Could not start ambient soundtrack:', e);
        }
    }

    stopAmbientMusic() {
        this._bgmToken = (this._bgmToken || 0) + 1;
        if (this._musicMotion) { clearInterval(this._musicMotion); this._musicMotion = null; }
        this.ambientOscillators.forEach(entry => { try { entry.lfo?.stop(); } catch(e) {} try { entry.osc?.stop(); } catch(e) {} });
        this.ambientOscillators = [];
        if (this.ambientNoise) { try { this.ambientNoise.noise?.stop(); } catch(e) {} this.ambientNoise = null; }
    }

    setAmbientMood(world) {
        this.ambientMood = ['moon','orbit','mars'].includes(world) ? world : 'moon';
    }

    _syncMusicGain() {
        if (this.ambientGain && this.ctx) {
            const target = Math.max(0.0001, this.getEffectiveMusicVolume());
            this.ambientGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.muted || this.musicMuted ? 0 : target, this.ctx.currentTime, 0.08);
        }
    }

    setMusicVolume(vol) {
        this.musicVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
        if (!this.initialized && this.musicVolume > 0) this.init();
        this._syncMusicGain();
        this._saveSettings();
        this.updateAudioButton();
    }

    setSfxVolume(vol) {
        this.sfxVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
        this._saveSettings();
        this.updateAudioButton();
    }

    setVoiceVolume(vol) {
        this.voiceVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
        if (window.VoiceLayer?._current) {
            window.VoiceLayer._current.volume = this.getEffectiveVoiceVolume();
        }
        this._saveSettings();
        this.updateAudioButton();
    }

    setVoiceDucked(active) {
        this._voiceDucked = !!active;
        this._syncMusicGain();
    }

    setMasterVolume(vol) {
        this.masterVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
        this._syncMusicGain();
        if (window.VoiceLayer?._current) window.VoiceLayer._current.volume = this.getEffectiveVoiceVolume();
        this._saveSettings();
        this.updateAudioButton();
    }

    toggleMusicMute() {
        this.musicMuted = !this.musicMuted;
        if (!this.musicMuted && !this.initialized) this.init();
        this._syncMusicGain();
        this._saveSettings();
        this.updateAudioButton();
        return this.musicMuted;
    }

    toggleSfxMute() {
        this.sfxMuted = !this.sfxMuted;
        if (this.sfxMuted) this.stopAlarm();
        this._saveSettings();
        this.updateAudioButton();
        return this.sfxMuted;
    }

    toggleVoiceMute() {
        this.voiceMuted = !this.voiceMuted;
        if (window.VoiceLayer?._current) window.VoiceLayer._current.volume = this.getEffectiveVoiceVolume();
        this._saveSettings();
        this.updateAudioButton();
        return this.voiceMuted;
    }

    updateAudioButton() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('audioToggleBtn');
        if (btn) {
            const allMuted = this.muted || (this.musicMuted && this.sfxMuted && this.voiceMuted);
            btn.innerHTML = allMuted ? '🔇 <span>AUDIO</span>' : '🎵 <span>AUDIO</span>';
            btn.title = 'Open Audio & Music Controls';
            btn.classList.toggle('is-muted', allMuted);
        }
        window.AudioController?.syncUI?.();
    }

    toggleMute() {
        this.muted = !this.muted;
        if (this.muted) {
            this.stopAlarm();
        } else {
            if (!this.initialized) this.init();
            this.resume();
            if (!this.ambientOscillators.length) this.startAmbientMusic();
        }
        this._syncMusicGain();
        if (window.VoiceLayer?._current) window.VoiceLayer._current.volume = this.getEffectiveVoiceVolume();
        this._saveSettings();
        this.updateAudioButton();
        return this.muted;
    }
}

window.NativeAudioConstructor = window.Audio;
window.Audio = new SoundEngine();
window.AudioController = {
    engine: window.Audio,
    getState() {
        const a = window.Audio;
        return {
            musicVolume: Math.round(a.musicVolume * 100),
            sfxVolume: Math.round(a.sfxVolume * 100),
            voiceVolume: Math.round(a.voiceVolume * 100),
            musicMuted: a.musicMuted,
            sfxMuted: a.sfxMuted,
            voiceMuted: a.voiceMuted,
            masterMuted: a.muted
        };
    },
    mountUI() {
        if (document.getElementById('msAudioMixer')) return;
        const bar = document.querySelector('.hud-actions-group');
        if (bar && !document.getElementById('audioToggleBtn')) {
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.className = 'hud-btn';
            btn.id = 'audioToggleBtn';
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.innerHTML = '🎵 <span>AUDIO</span>';
            btn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); this.togglePanel(); };
            bar.appendChild(btn);
        }
        const pop = document.createElement('div');
        pop.id = 'msAudioMixer';
        pop.className = 'ms-audio-mixer';
        pop.hidden = true;
        pop.innerHTML = `
          <div class="ms-am-head">
            <span>🎵 AUDIO &amp; MUSIC</span>
            <button type="button" class="ms-am-master" id="msAmMasterBtn">MUTE ALL</button>
          </div>
          <div class="ms-am-row">
            <button type="button" class="ms-am-mute" id="msAmMusicMute" title="Mute Music">🎵</button>
            <div class="ms-am-meta"><span>Music</span><strong id="msAmMusicPct">42%</strong></div>
            <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="42" id="msAmMusicRange" aria-label="Music Volume">
          </div>
          <div class="ms-am-row">
            <button type="button" class="ms-am-mute" id="msAmSfxMute" title="Mute Sound Effects">🔊</button>
            <div class="ms-am-meta"><span>Sound FX</span><strong id="msAmSfxPct">75%</strong></div>
            <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="75" id="msAmSfxRange" aria-label="Sound Effects Volume">
          </div>
          <div class="ms-am-row">
            <button type="button" class="ms-am-mute" id="msAmVoiceMute" title="Mute Crew Voices">🎙️</button>
            <div class="ms-am-meta"><span>Crew Voices</span><strong id="msAmVoicePct">100%</strong></div>
            <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="100" id="msAmVoiceRange" aria-label="Crew Voice Volume">
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(pop);
        const a = window.Audio;
        pop.querySelector('#msAmMusicRange').oninput = (e) => a.setMusicVolume(Number(e.target.value) / 100);
        pop.querySelector('#msAmSfxRange').oninput = (e) => { a.setSfxVolume(Number(e.target.value) / 100); a.uiClick(); };
        pop.querySelector('#msAmVoiceRange').oninput = (e) => a.setVoiceVolume(Number(e.target.value) / 100);
        pop.querySelector('#msAmMusicMute').onclick = () => a.toggleMusicMute();
        pop.querySelector('#msAmSfxMute').onclick = () => a.toggleSfxMute();
        pop.querySelector('#msAmVoiceMute').onclick = () => a.toggleVoiceMute();
        pop.querySelector('#msAmMasterBtn').onclick = () => a.toggleMute();
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (!pop.hidden && !pop.contains(e.target) && e.target.id !== 'audioToggleBtn' && !e.target.closest('#audioToggleBtn')) {
                pop.hidden = true;
            }
        });
        this.syncUI();
    },
    togglePanel() {
        this.mountUI();
        const pop = document.getElementById('msAudioMixer');
        if (!pop) return;
        pop.hidden = !pop.hidden;
        if (!pop.hidden) this.syncUI();
    },
    syncUI() {
        const pop = document.getElementById('msAudioMixer');
        if (!pop) return;
        const st = this.getState();
        pop.querySelector('#msAmMusicRange').value = st.musicVolume;
        pop.querySelector('#msAmMusicPct').textContent = (st.musicMuted || st.masterMuted) ? 'MUTED' : st.musicVolume + '%';
        pop.querySelector('#msAmMusicMute').classList.toggle('is-muted', st.musicMuted || st.masterMuted);
        pop.querySelector('#msAmSfxRange').value = st.sfxVolume;
        pop.querySelector('#msAmSfxPct').textContent = (st.sfxMuted || st.masterMuted) ? 'MUTED' : st.sfxVolume + '%';
        pop.querySelector('#msAmSfxMute').classList.toggle('is-muted', st.sfxMuted || st.masterMuted);
        pop.querySelector('#msAmVoiceRange').value = st.voiceVolume;
        pop.querySelector('#msAmVoicePct').textContent = (st.voiceMuted || st.masterMuted) ? 'MUTED' : st.voiceVolume + '%';
        pop.querySelector('#msAmVoiceMute').classList.toggle('is-muted', st.voiceMuted || st.masterMuted);
        const mb = pop.querySelector('#msAmMasterBtn');
        mb.textContent = st.masterMuted ? 'UNMUTE ALL' : 'MUTE ALL';
        mb.classList.toggle('is-muted', st.masterMuted);
    }
};
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { window.Audio.updateAudioButton(); window.AudioController.mountUI(); });
</script>
    <script>
/**
 * MOONSHIFT voice layer – 67 user-recorded lines (no speech synthesis).
 * The game requires one real user gesture before recorded audio playback (browser autoplay policy).
 * The recording events drive dialogue captions and lifecycle, so captions never
 * race ahead of audio. Word-level timestamps are not supplied, so captions remain fully visible.
 */
window.MoonshiftRecordedClips = {"fatema":{"far from home, our crew is learning how to live beyond earth. today, you are joining us.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","wait! that's our new astronaut? i practiced my welcome speech forty-seven times!":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","something interesting is happening. ready to investigate together?":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","you made it! i'm fatema, your new robot buddy. i've practiced my welcome speech 47 times!":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","our pretend moon base is called luna-7. follow the corridor to the big glowing globe!":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,
